findings.text: follow-on: the exact-set assertion validators == {_apply_set, _require_authored_section_fields, _apply_collapse_section} reddens when a legitimate fourth caller of is_section_identity is added to the store, the same count-over-source brittleness the two removed count(...) pins carried and §20 exists to remove; assert containment of the three (that they call the helper) rather than exact set equality, so an unrelated addition does not redden the guard.

follow-on: the assertion not (validators & inline_full_match) only rejects an inline full-match inside a function that also calls is_section_identity, so a new section-id validation that performs an inline full-match without routing through the helper is in neither set and escapes both assertions, leaving the guard narrower than the docstring's claim that every section-identity refusal routes through the helper and none performs an inline full match.
